name: Valera Health
one_liner: Virtual psychiatry and therapy for moderate to severe mental illness, with a care team of clinicians and coaches, in nine states.
best_for: People with severe depression, bipolar disorder or other serious conditions who want psychiatry and therapy from one team by video
People on Medicaid or Medicare in its states
Teens 12 and up (6 and up in Massachusetts) who need virtual psychiatric care
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988, or call 911
People outside CO, CT, MA, NJ, NY, OH, PA, VT and WA
People who need inpatient or in-person intensive care
short_description: Team-based virtual psychiatry and therapy for higher-need mental health conditions in nine states, billed to commercial, Medicaid or Medicare plans.
long_description: Valera Health is a virtual mental health practice focused on people with moderate to severe or high-acuity conditions, such as severe depression and serious mental illness. Patients get a team that can include psychiatric prescribers, therapists and health coaches, with video visits and an app for messaging, forms and check-ins; it tracks progress with regular questionnaires. Its FAQ lists Colorado, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Vermont and Washington. Its providers treat ages 12 and up, and Massachusetts materials describe a program for children 6 and up. Valera bills commercial, Medicaid and Medicare plans (coverage varies by plan) and lists self-pay rates that vary by state and clinician; a $50 fee applies to no-shows and cancellations within 48 hours. In 2025 it acquired Vita Health, a suicide prevention program. No published study of Valera's outcomes was found. App reviews mention scheduling problems and app bugs.
patient_summary: You get a care team by video, which can include a psychiatric prescriber, a therapist and a health coach, and you use the Valera app for messaging and check-ins. It is mainly for people with more serious conditions and is billed to commercial insurance, Medicaid or Medicare. It serves ages 12 and up, or 6 and up in Massachusetts.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance (commercial, Medicaid or Medicare); self-pay rates vary by state and clinician
pricing.notes: Accepts most commercial, Medicaid and Medicare plans; copays vary by plan. Self-pay rates are listed on its billing FAQ and vary by state and provider license. $50 fee for no-shows or cancellations within 48 hours.

privacy.notes: Website policy says it takes part in advertising networks that track your activity with cookies and web beacons to tailor ads; patient records fall under its HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices.

faqs.q: What type of patients does Valera Health treat?
faqs.a: Valera Health specializes in high-acuity mental health care for patients ages 6+ with serious mental illness (SMI) and severe depression, using a team-based care model.

faqs.q: What is Valera Health's care model?
faqs.a: Valera uses team-based care with health coaches, therapists, and physicians working together. Patients are matched to a dedicated care team, with ongoing longitudinal care supported by a unified EMR.

faqs.q: Does Valera Health use measurement-based care?
faqs.a: Yes, Valera collects patient-reported outcome measures at various intervals using their unified digital platform, emphasizing both process and outcome measures.
Yes, Valera Health has received NCQA accreditation for Credentialing and Recredentialing.

Therapy for moderate to severe conditions
